entries.title: Job 5:1
segments: ¶Call, I pray thee! Is there any that answereth thee? and to which of the holy ones wilt thou turn?

entries.title: Job 5:2
segments: For vexation killeth the foolish man, and envy slayeth the simple.

entries.title: Job 5:3
segments: I myself saw the foolish taking root, but suddenly I cursed his habitation.

entries.title: Job 5:4
segments: His children are far from safety, and they are crushed in the gate, and there is no deliverer:

entries.title: Job 5:5
segments: Whose harvest the hungry eateth up, and taketh even out of the thorns; and the snare gapeth for his substance.

entries.title: Job 5:6
segments: ¶For evil cometh not forth from the dust, neither doth trouble spring out of the ground;

entries.title: Job 5:7
segments: For man is born to trouble, as the sparks fly upwards.

entries.title: Job 5:8
segments: But as for me I will seek unto *God, and unto God commit my cause;

entries.title: Job 5:9
segments: Who doeth great things and unsearchable, marvellous things without number;

entries.title: Job 5:10
segments: Who giveth rain on the face of the earth, and sendeth waters on the face of the fields;

entries.title: Job 5:11
segments: Setting up on high those that are low; and mourners are exalted to prosperity.

entries.title: Job 5:12
segments: He disappointeth the devices of the crafty, and their hands carry not out the enterprise.

entries.title: Job 5:13
segments: He taketh the wise in their own craftiness; and the counsel of the wily is carried headlong:

entries.title: Job 5:14
segments: They meet with darkness in the daytime, and grope at midday as in the night.

entries.title: Job 5:15
segments: And he saveth the needy from the sword, from their mouth, and from the hand of the mighty.

entries.title: Job 5:16
segments: So the poor hath what he hopeth for, and unrighteousness stoppeth her mouth.

entries.title: Job 5:17
segments: ¶Behold, happy is the man whom +God correcteth; therefore despise not the chastening of the Almighty.

entries.title: Job 5:18
segments: For he maketh sore, and bindeth up; he woundeth, and his hands make whole.

entries.title: Job 5:19
segments: He will deliver thee in six troubles, and in seven there shall no evil touch thee.

entries.title: Job 5:20
segments: In famine he will redeem thee from death, and in war from the power of the sword.

entries.title: Job 5:21
segments: Thou shalt be hidden from the scourge of the tongue; and thou shalt not be afraid of destruction when it cometh.

entries.title: Job 5:22
segments: At destruction and famine thou shalt laugh, and of the beasts of the earth thou shalt not be afraid.

entries.title: Job 5:23
segments: For thou shalt be in league with the stones of the field, and the beasts of the field shall be at peace with thee.

entries.title: Job 5:24
segments: And thou shalt know that thy tent is in peace; and thou wilt survey thy fold, and miss nothing.

entries.title: Job 5:25
segments: And thou shalt know that thy seed is numerous, and thine offspring as the herb of the earth.

entries.title: Job 5:26
segments: Thou shalt come to the grave in a ripe age, as a shock of corn is brought in in its season.

entries.title: Job 5:27
segments: Behold this, we have searched it out, so it is; hear it, and know thou it for thyself.
